mkdir -p /root/turn_residual_gating/scripts && cat > /root/turn_residual_gating/scripts/run_4way_eval.sh << 'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python3.12
EVAL_SCRIPT=/root/turn_residual_gating/src/eval_phase2_gar.py
CONV_PATH=/root/turn_residual_gating/data/ultrachat_eval_sample.json
OUT_ROOT=/root/turn_residual_gating/runs/4way_eval

TG_CKPT=/root/turn_residual_gating/runs/phase2_tg_s42_v7
UG_CKPT=/root/turn_residual_gating/runs/phase2_ug_s42
LO_CKPT=/root/turn_residual_gating/runs/phase2_lora_only_s42

mkdir -p "$OUT_ROOT"

# ── Base (ours) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "========== [1/8] Base + ours =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type none \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/base_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

# ── Base (dongre) ────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "========== [2/8] Base + dongre =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type none \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/base_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

# ── TG v7 (ours) ────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "========== [3/8] TG v7 + ours =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --checkpoint-dir "$TG_CKPT" \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tg_v7_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

# ── TG v7 (dongre) ──────────────────────────────────────────
echo "========== [4/8] TG v7 + dongre =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --checkpoint-dir "$TG_CKPT" \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tg_v7_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

# ── UG (ours) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "========== [5/8] UG + ours =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type uniform \
  --checkpoint-dir "$UG_CKPT" \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ug_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

# ── UG (dongre) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "========== [6/8] UG + dongre =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type uniform \
  --checkpoint-dir "$UG_CKPT" \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ug_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

# ── LoRA-only (ours) ─────────────────────────────────────────
echo "========== [7/8] LoRA-only + ours =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type none \
  --checkpoint-dir "$LO_CKPT" \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/lora_only_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

# ── LoRA-only (dongre) ───────────────────────────────────────
echo "========== [8/8] LoRA-only + dongre =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type none \
  --checkpoint-dir "$LO_CKPT" \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/lora_only_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

echo "========== All 8 evals done =========="
echo "Results in: $OUT_ROOT"
SCRIPT_EOF
echo "Script written."
